beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Anti-Trivialization Machines of the Future asks how institutions can protect serious attention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its argument concerns the organization of influence, rather than individual failures of willpower.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book explores cognitive assistance, attention rules, provenance, and institutions for longer time horizons.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It favors plural, limited institutions over one authority deciding what everyone should consider important.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers can examine these proposals without accepting that their eventual arrival is guaranteed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: More information does not automatically produce a greater capacity for sustained judgment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines incentives that interrupt attention, compress time, and reward immediate response.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It places AI within that institutional setting instead of treating distraction as a new personal defect.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The question is how important problems can remain visible long enough for collective action.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That shift explains why the proposed countermeasures extend beyond better individual habits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposals include cognitive assistance aligned with declared goals and limits on adaptive influence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Other institutions would support provenance, protected time, and longer decision horizons.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different communities require different arrangements for attention and evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book rejects one central authority assigning seriousness or truth to everyone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its alternative depends on plural institutions that can inspect and counterbalance one another.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the distinction between condemning entertainment and preserving the capacity for serious thought.
